ftbquests.task.tensura_quests.counter.ta: Progress required before the quest completes. Intake beyond it is clamped.
ftbquests.task.tensura_quests.job_master: The job this task tracks. The quest bar shows the player's level in it, capped at the required level.
The job level at which the quest completes. Levels below it never complete; the task reads the job itself, not the active job.
ftbquests.task.tensura_quests.multi_job_: Every entry must hold at once, written as jobid:level (for example miner:10). The bar sums each job's level toward its own requirement and completes only when every entry is satisfied.
ftbquests.task.tensura_quests.job_partic: The job the player must hold. Completes once the job is acquired, at any level.
ftbquests.task.tensura_quests.player_tra: Completed trades required. The player's own purchases and sales both count, each side of a trade credited to its own player; cancelled trades never count.

Off by default: trades between players on the same team count for nobody, so alternate accounts cannot farm the objective. Turn on for cooperative play where teammates shop from each other on purpose.
ftbquests.task.tensura_quests.sales_mile: Total sale value required from the player's own traders. Only completed sales count; free trades add nothing.
Off by default: sales to players on the same team count for nobody, so alternate accounts cannot farm the milestone. Turn on for cooperative play where teammates shop from each other on purpose.
ftbquests.task.tensura_quests.trading_pa: How many different players the objective-taker must complete trades with. Repeating a trade with the same player counts once; both people on a trade each earn the other as a partner.

Off by default: trades between players on the same team count for nobody, so alternate accounts cannot farm the partner count. Turn on for cooperative play where teammates shop from each other on purpose.
ftbquests.task.tensura_quests.completion: How the team's personal counters must be met: any member completes as soon as one member reaches the target; every member needs all members at check time, so a member without progress keeps the task incomplete.
Text shown to the claiming player. A blank message fails the claim loudly and stays claimable.
